title: Music, B.M. -- Keyboard Instruments Option (College of Arts and Architecture)
notes: Keyboard Instruments Option (of four: Composition, Keyboard Instruments, Strings/Winds/Brass/Percussion, Voice -- Keyboard chosen since it reuses the most already-built MUSIC catalog data from the Music B.A. and Music Education B.M.E. builds, and its Applied Music sequence (KEYBD 130-480) is fully named rather than an open pool). Entrance is by departmental evaluation, not modeled directly. New keybd_catalog.json for the 8-course KEYBD applied-piano sequence (confirmed to have no enforced catalog prereqs between levels -- placement is by audition/jury, not encoded in the bulletin's prereq fields). Extended music_catalog.json with 14 more 3xx/4xx courses. 'Ensemble' is modeled as a generic slot every semester (varies by student, same convention as the Music B.A./B.M.E. builds). The three repeated 'MUSIC 419/424' (Piano Pedagogy I/II), 'MUSIC 461W/462W/463W/464W' (Music History studies pool, each repeatable to 6cr), and 'MUSIC 422/431/433/461W/462W/463W/472' pools rely on the engine's tiered option ranking to advance through distinct eligible options each time, same convention as Graphic Design's repeated 'GD 300/315/320/400' pool. Several semesters' bulletin-stated credit totals didn't fully reconcile against their itemized course lists (a recurring minor source-summarization gap this session) -- closed with generic Gen Ed/Elective padding rather than forced precision; the resulting 8-semester total (~120cr) matches the bulletin's own stated Keyboard option total closely. 2026-08-27 re-verification against the real School of Music 2025-26 Undergraduate Handbook (sites.psu.edu/music/files/2025/09/UG-Music-Handbook-25-26-9-16.pdf): found ENGL 202A/B/C/D was missing from the entire plan (confirmed via grep) -- the bulletin places it (3cr) in Third Year Spring (Semester 6), which had a plain GEN ED slot in that exact spot instead; replaced it with the real ENGL 202 course item (every other Music plan built this session -- MUSED, MUSIC B.A., MUSTECH -- already had it; MUSICBM was the outlier). Known documented gap, not fixed: the handbook's keyboard-specific Ensemble sub-rule (2 of the 8 Ensemble credits must specifically be MUSIC 193 Sonata Duos or MUSIC 194 Studio-Recital Accompanying) isn't encoded -- Ensemble here is still a generic per-semester slot, same convention as every other Music plan in this session; narrowing it would need a per-degree sub-quota mechanism the engine doesn't have.
